text: Great schools are built on meaningful conversations—and great teachers are inspired by purposeful leadership.

Following the Parents' Forum and Children's Forum, Mrs. Amrita Burman, Director, Sunbeam Group of Educational Institutions, met with the teachers of Sunbeam School Ballia to share key insights and feedback gathered from both parents and students.

The interaction was not just a review, but a motivating dialogue that celebrated strengths, identified opportunities for growth, and reaffirmed the high standards of teaching and care that define the Sunbeam legacy.

At Sunbeam, feedback completes its journey only when it transforms into action. By listening to parents, understanding students, and empowering teachers, we ensure that excellence is not just promised—it is consistently delivered.
Because the strongest classrooms are built by teachers who learn, grow, and lead every single day.

A Children's Forum is a platform where students openly share their experiences, ideas, and feedback, helping schools understand how learning is truly being experienced by those who matter most—the students themselves.

At Sunbeam School Ballia, the forum was conducted by Mrs. Amrita Burman, Director, Sunbeam Group of Educational Institutions, along with the expert team from DHK Eduserve, creating an open and engaging space for students to express themselves freely.

Because the true measure of quality lies in the experience of its actual consumers. At Sunbeam, we listen, we learn, and we continuously refine our delivery to ensure every child receives the very best.
Sunbeam School Ballia had the distinct privilege of hosting Mrs. Amrita Burman, Eminent Educationist and Director, Sunbeam Group of Educational Institutions, for an enriching edition of Tête-à-Tête.

Her visionary thoughts, invaluable experiences, and unwavering commitment to holistic education inspired every listener present. The interaction was more than a conversation—it was a masterclass in leadership, excellence, and purposeful learning.
At Sunbeam School Ballia, we believe that such meaningful engagements broaden horizons, ignite aspirations, and empower our learners to dream bigger and achieve higher.
We extend our heartfelt gratitude to Mrs. Amrita Burman for gracing our campus.

Honouring the legacy of the Sikh Gurus through learning, reflection, and values. Our students celebrated Sikh Gurus & Their Teachings Week with enthusiasm, embracing the timeless messages of selfless service, equality, compassion, courage, and humanity.
Learning comes alive through hands-on experiences at Sunbeam School Ballia!

Our young learners explored the first steps of farming by preparing the soil, carefully sowing seeds, covering them with earth, and watering them with care. Through this engaging activity, they discovered that every healthy plant begins with patience, nurturing, and the perfect balance of sunlight, air, and water.
By connecting with nature, our students are cultivating not just plants, but also curiosity, responsibility, and a lifelong appreciation for the environment.

Her wisdom, leadership, and unwavering commitment to education continue to shape generations of learners and educators. Together, we celebrate the power of collaboration between parents, children, and schools in building brighter futures.

Literacy Project for Educators is a nationwide initiative dedicated to strengthening financial and food literacy among teachers through expert-led learning and practical classroom implementation, creating a lasting impact on students and communities.

This meaningful initiative is organized by the Good Schools Alliance, a collaborative platform committed to fostering innovation, capacity building, and excellence across educational institutions, in association with Sunbeam School, Ballia, a leading institution dedicated to holistic learning and academic excellence.
Together, we look forward to empowering educators who will shape informed, responsible, and future-ready generations.
Pradiptam 2.0 | Alumni Meet 2026–27 was a heartfelt celebration of memories, friendships, and the timeless bond that every Sunbeam carries forever.

From revisiting classrooms to reliving unforgettable moments, every smile reflected a story, every reunion rekindled a connection, and every conversation reminded us that once a Sunbeam, always a Sunbeam.
Here's to the memories that shaped us and the legacy that continues to inspire generations.
Physics begins not with formulas, but with the simple act of wondering why things happen.

Inspired by the profound insights of Padma Shri Prof. H. C. Verma our PGT Physics faculty—Mr. Neeraj, Mr. Avinash, and Mr. Rajat—proudly represented Sunbeam School Ballia at the National Level Workshop on Teaching and Learning Physics held at Sunbeam School Mughalsarai.

Over three enriching days, the workshop celebrated curiosity, experimentation, and the belief that every child is a born scientist. Through engaging demonstrations, meaningful discussions, and interactive learning experiences, participants explored innovative approaches to making Physics more experiential, inquiry-driven, and relatable.

At Sunbeam School Ballia, we remain committed to empowering our educators with continuous professional development, ensuring our students benefit from inspiring, concept-based learning that extends far beyond the classroom.

school-activities.title: First Parents Orientation Program – A Grand Success! 🌟 Today, on 16th January 2025, we proudly hosted our 1st Parents Orientation Program, welcoming 260 students and 336 enthusiastic parents from classes Nursery to IX to our campus. The event began with a warm welcome by our Director and Principal, who shared the school’s vision, mission, academic achievements, emphasis on co-curricular activities and new addition done in our school and curriculum. They highlighted how we are dedicated to the holistic development of our students, nurturing them to excel in every aspect of life. The program also featured a Parents Interface Session, where parents had the opportunity to interact one-on-one with the leadership team, fostering a stronger school-community bond. For our youngest learners from Nursery to Grade II, engaging Multiple Intelligence (MI) Stations were set up, offering fun-filled activities and games that kept the little ones happily occupied throughout the day. It was a memorable and fruitful day, filled with collaboration, learning, and a shared vision for our children’s bright future. We thank all the parents for their active participation and support! Together, we are shaping tomorrow's leaders! 💙
